data.name: Ibero Massa Florestal
data.description: Ibero Massa Florestal (IMF) is a Portuguese biochar producer based in Oliveira de Azeméis that transforms forest biomass through slow pyrolysis into Ecochar (agricultural biochar) and Carvão Zero (household charcoal), with an installed capacity of 5,000 tonnes/year. The company is certified under EBC, GLOBAL C-SINK, FSC, PEFC, DIN Plus, SURE and ISO 9001, and partners with Carbonfuture to sell biochar carbon removal credits.
